edits.before: Q-chord the contacts — the aura poke is quiet and constant; the lane pays per note.
edits.after: Blooming Burst (Q) and the growing Tangle-Barbs (E) root out-range Hymn of Valor — you can't win the poke war, so hug XP and concede contested CS.

edits.before: W answers the trades: the sustain mirror opens and yours compounds.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs (E) chains through minions into a burst combo that wins the trade outright; hold Aria (W) to top off chip rather than stand and trade.

edits.before: Full kit: the chord colors decide trades — power chord the carry, speed the disengage.
edits.after: Full kit online, but her superior poke and burst still keep you zoned off CS — Power Chord doesn't close the range gap yet.

edits.before: Aura economy: chip, heal, speed — the margins are invisible and decisive.
edits.after: Her damage lead persists ahead of your items — Blooming Burst plus Tangle-Barbs keeps out-trading your early kit.

edits.before: Crescendo online — grouped lanes pay the dance tax; your duo's all-in has a stage.

edits.before: First item: the auras compound and the chords chunk.
edits.after: Neeko keeps the edge at first item — Tangle-Barbs into Pop Blossom can chunk or kill through your shields if you group, so stay spread and shield reactively.

edits.after: She out-pokes the aura — heal through what you can, dodge the keystone, and scale past the rotation.

edits.after: Neeko's Passive disguise hides her approach, so treat every unarmed minion, ward, or ally as a possible Flash into Pop Blossom (R) before you commit.
